Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (Analysis of Previous Result), the Planner incorrectly asserted that "Eldon is in Morgan County." The WebSurfer had only provided the birthplace as "Eldon, Missouri" without specifying the county. The Planner hallucinated the county name instead of verifying it via another search or checking the Wikipedia link mentioned in the search results. This factual error led to the final incorrect answer of "Morgan County" instead of the correct "Miller County."
